public_rationale: The forecast has no deadline, but its conditional premise must first be established. The records do not show that every subscriber and API call lost money at publication. Company-wide losses cannot establish that premise. The conditional forecast therefore cannot be scored, even if investors later expressed concerns about financing.
limitations: Private investor discussions may not be public.
The universal unit-loss premise requires much more specific evidence than aggregate company accounts.
Neither fundraising success nor the absence of public concern disproves an eventual forecast.

conditions: every subscriber or API call loses money

statement.excerpt: When every subscriber or API call loses you money, growth only exists to help flog your company to investors, and at some point investors will begin to question whether this company can stand on its own two feet.

from_speaker: every subscriber or API call loses you money
at some point investors will begin to question
whether this company can stand on its own two feet
our_interpretation: This is conditional on negative unit economics for OpenAI subscribers and API calls, not merely a company-wide accounting loss.
The antecedent describes conditions at publication; use the latest completed quarter, July–September 2024, to seek contemporaneous unit economics.
An investor questioning whether OpenAI can become self-financing would satisfy the predicted event. General AI skepticism or an analyst's comments would not suffice.
At some point supplies no deadline.
The claim about growth existing only to attract investors is treated as the speaker's explanation, not as a separately measurable assertion about every motive.
criteria.support_condition: After the antecedent is established, an identified OpenAI investor publicly questions its ability to become self-financing, or credible reporting documents that concern in financing negotiations and links it to continuing operating losses.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After the antecedent is established, a decisive terminal event makes future questioning by OpenAI investors impossible without such questioning having occurred. Continued investment or current expressions of confidence alone cannot contradict an unlimited eventual forecast.
